description: This is a Python migration script for the Superset project, specifically handling database schema upgrades/downgrades related to 'num_period_compare' and 'period_ratio_type' in chart parameters.

classes.name: Slice
classes.description: Represents a chart slice with id, datasource_type, and params fields.

methods.name: isodate_duration_to_string
methods.description: Converts an isodate duration object to a human-readable string.

methods.name: timedelta_to_string
methods.description: Converts a datetime.timedelta object to a human-readable string.

methods.name: format_seconds
methods.description: Formats seconds into the largest appropriate time unit string.

methods.name: compute_time_compare
methods.description: Calculates a time comparison string based on granularity and periods.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs database migration to update chart parameters with time comparison info.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Reverts the migration changes by removing time comparison info from chart parameters.
